title: 同一种运算，更小的世界
The same operation on a smaller set
text: 子群 H 是 G 的非空子集，在 G 的同一运算下自身成为群。结合律直接继承；真正要检查的是乘积和逆元是否仍留在 H 中。
A subgroup is a nonempty subset that is a group under the inherited operation. Associativity is inherited; closure and inverses are the essential checks.
example: 在加法群 ℤ 中，2ℤ 是子群；正整数集不是，因为没有 0，也不包含负元。
In (ℤ,+), 2ℤ is a subgroup. The positive integers are not: they lack 0 and additive inverses.

title: 子群判别法
The subgroup criterion
entries.tex: \varnothing\ne H\subseteq G:\quad H\le G\iff (\forall a,b\in H)\ ab^{-1}\in H
text: 对非空子集 H，封闭于 ab⁻¹ 当且仅当 H 是子群。非空这一条件不能省略。
A nonempty subset H is a subgroup exactly when ab⁻¹ belongs to H for every a,b in H. Nonemptiness is essential.
proof: 必要性：子群对逆元和乘法封闭，所以 ab⁻¹∈H。
Necessity: a subgroup is closed under inverses and products.
充分性：取 h∈H，则 hh⁻¹=e∈H。
Sufficiency: choose h∈H. Then hh⁻¹=e∈H.
取 a∈H，用 e、a 得 ea⁻¹=a⁻¹∈H。
For a∈H, use e and a to obtain a⁻¹∈H.
取 a,b∈H，已知 b⁻¹∈H，故 a(b⁻¹)⁻¹=ab∈H；结合律继承自 G。
Now b⁻¹∈H implies a(b⁻¹)⁻¹=ab∈H. Associativity is inherited.

title: 有限非空子集的判别
The finite-subset criterion
text: 群的有限非空子集，只要对乘法封闭，就是子群。无限子集没有这条捷径。
A finite nonempty subset of a group is a subgroup if and only if it is closed under products. Finiteness cannot be dropped.
proof: 必要性由子群定义立即得到。以下假设 H 有限非空且乘法封闭。
Necessity is immediate. Assume H is finite, nonempty and closed under products.
对 h∈H，正幂 h,h²,… 全在 H 中；有限性给出 hⁱ=hʲ，其中 i<j。
All positive powers of h lie in H. Finiteness gives hⁱ=hʲ with i<j.
在 G 中消去得 hʲ⁻ⁱ=e，所以 e∈H。若 j−i>1，则 hʲ⁻ⁱ⁻¹=h⁻¹∈H；若 j−i=1，则 h=e。
Cancellation in G gives hʲ⁻ⁱ=e∈H. If j−i>1 the preceding power is h⁻¹; if j−i=1 then h=e.
每个元素的逆元都在 H 中，结合原有的乘法封闭性，即得子群。
Every inverse lies in H, so closure under products proves that H is a subgroup.
warning: ℤ 中的正整数对加法封闭，却不是子群：有限性用在“幂必重复”这一步。
The positive integers are closed under addition but are not a subgroup of ℤ. Finiteness forces powers to repeat.

title: 交集与并集
Intersections and unions
text: 任意非空族的子群之交仍为子群；子群的并一般不是子群。
The intersection of a nonempty family of subgroups is a subgroup; a union need not be.
proof: 所有 Hᵢ 都包含 e，所以交集非空。
Every Hᵢ contains e, so the intersection is nonempty.
若 a、b 属于交集，则在每个 Hᵢ 中都有 ab⁻¹∈Hᵢ，因此 ab⁻¹ 仍属于交集。
If a,b lie in the intersection, ab⁻¹ lies in every Hᵢ and hence in the intersection.
example: 2ℤ∪3ℤ 不是 ℤ 的子群：2、3 在并集中，2+3=5 不在其中；2ℤ∩3ℤ=6ℤ。
2ℤ∪3ℤ is not a subgroup: 2 and 3 belong but 5 does not. Their intersection is 6ℤ.

title: 由一批元素生成子群
Generating a subgroup
text: ⟨S⟩ 是包含 S 的最小子群；它由 S 中元素及其逆元的所有有限乘积组成，并包含空乘积 e。
The subgroup generated by S is the smallest subgroup containing S. It consists of all finite products of elements of S and their inverses, including the empty product e.
proof: 所有包含 S 的子群之交是子群，而且包含 S。
The intersection of all subgroups containing S is a subgroup containing S.
令 W 为这些有限词的值。空词给出 e；词的拼接与倒序取逆说明 W 是子群。
Let W consist of the values of such words. The empty word gives e; concatenation and reversed inversion make W a subgroup.
W 包含 S，所以 ⟨S⟩⊆W；每个包含 S 的子群都包含这些词，所以 W⊆⟨S⟩。
W contains S, so ⟨S⟩⊆W. Every subgroup containing S contains the words, proving the reverse inclusion.

title: 中心与中心化子
Center and centralizers
text: 中心由与所有元素交换的元素组成；固定 a 的中心化子 C_G(a) 只要求与 a 交换。它们都是子群，且 Z(G)=⋂ₐC_G(a)。
The center consists of elements commuting with all of G. The centralizer C_G(a) consists of elements commuting with a. Both are subgroups, and the center is their intersection.
proof: 单位元与 a 交换。若 x、y 与 a 交换，则 y⁻¹ 也与 a 交换。
The identity commutes with a. If y commutes with a, so does y⁻¹.
于是 (xy⁻¹)a=x(ay⁻¹)=(xa)y⁻¹=a(xy⁻¹)，故 C_G(a) 满足子群判别。
Then (xy⁻¹)a=x(ay⁻¹)=(xa)y⁻¹=a(xy⁻¹), proving the subgroup criterion.
中心是这些中心化子的交，因此也是子群。
The center is the intersection of the centralizers and hence is a subgroup.
example: D₃ 的中心只有 e；C_D₃(r)={e,r,r²}。这将在共轭作用中再次出现。
The center of D₃ is {e}, while C_D₃(r)={e,r,r²}. Centralizers return in conjugation actions.

question: ℤ₆ 中哪一个集合是加法子群？
Which subset is an additive subgroup of ℤ₆?
reason: {0,2,4} 对减法封闭；其余各集不满足子群判别。
The first set is closed under subtraction; the others fail the subgroup criterion.

question: G 的非空子集 H 对乘法封闭，能立即推出什么？
A nonempty subset H is closed under products. What follows?
options: A subgroup if H is finite
reason: 有限性让正幂重复，从而得到单位元与逆元。无限情形可用正整数加法作反例。
Finiteness forces powers to repeat and supplies identity and inverses. Positive integers under addition refute the infinite case.

question: 2ℤ 与 3ℤ 生成的子群是什么？
What subgroup of ℤ is generated by 2ℤ and 3ℤ?
reason: 3−2=1 属于所生成子群，因此它包含所有整数。
The generated subgroup contains 3−2=1, so it is all of ℤ.

question: 若 H,K≤G，哪项总成立？
For H,K≤G, which always holds?
reason: 交集含单位元，并继承 ab⁻¹ 的封闭性。
The intersection contains the identity and is closed under ab⁻¹.

question: 证明：两个子群的并是子群，当且仅当其中一个包含另一个。
Prove that the union of two subgroups is a subgroup iff one contains the other.
reason: 包含方向显然。反向若都不包含，取 h∈H∖K、k∈K∖H。若 H∪K 为子群，则 hk 属于 H 或 K；前者推出 k=h⁻¹(hk)∈H，后者推出 h=(hk)k⁻¹∈K，均矛盾。
Containment makes the union a subgroup. Conversely choose h∈H∖K and k∈K∖H. If hk is in H then k is in H; if it is in K then h is in K. Both contradict the choices.
